r:
evictcontrol

Runs TPM2_EvictControl

-hi
authhandle hierarchy (o, p) o owner, p platform
-ho
object handle if transient: make persistent, if persistent: flush
-hp
persistent handle owner 81000000 to 817FFFFF platform 81800000 to 81FFFFFF
-pwda
authorization password (default empty)

-se[0-2] session handle / attributes (default PWAP)

01
continue
